stories.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia's CEO and director with immediate effect after reports of extramarital affairs, one with a suspected Chinese intelligence asset; CFO Colette Kress becomes interim CEO, Harvey Jones becomes Nvidia's first chair, the board searches internally and externally; Nvidia has lost about $550B of value in five days and Huang has agreed to testify to Congress by Thanksgiving
stories.short: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO and director with immediate effect on 12 November after reports of two affairs, one with a woman US media say is a suspected Chinese intelligence asset. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO and Harvey Jones is Nvidia's first chair. Nvidia lost about $550bn of value in five days.

stat.label: Nvidia market value lost in five days (BBC)

stories.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen to everyone: a fast execution model for coding and agents at $1.50/$7.50 per million tokens across a 1M-token context, which Google says beats its class on several agent benchmarks; it also adds Orchestrator in Antigravity, which switches between Carbon and Hydrogen in one session (near-Carbon success on Terminal-Bench 4.0 with 24% less quota), and upgrades Search
stories.short: Google released Gemini 4 Hydrogen to developers, businesses and consumers on 12 November: a fast model for coding and agents at $1.50 in and $7.50 out per million tokens with a 1M-token context. A new Orchestrator in Antigravity switches between Carbon and Hydrogen mid-task; Google says it matches Carbon more cheaply.

stat.label: Hydrogen input price per million tokens

stories.title: Anthropic's amended IPO prospectus (10 Nov) says it has determined it meets its Responsible Scaling Policy threshold for dramatically accelerated AI R&D, based on expected future models and its rate of progress rather than current models; Bloomberg reports the IPO book is about six times oversubscribed and the FT says bankers may price above the $70-78 range
stories.short: Anthropic's amended IPO prospectus says it has met its own safety threshold for AI dramatically speeding up AI research, judged on expected future models rather than current ones. Bloomberg says the IPO book is about six times oversubscribed and the FT says bankers may price above $70-78. Listing is expected around 19 November.

stories.title: A global Microsoft 365 outage from about 18:00 UTC on 12 Nov takes down Exchange Online/Outlook, Teams, Copilot and Defender for Office 365, plus admin tools such as Intune; Microsoft says servers failing automated health checks became unavailable, its first fixes gave no relief, and recovery was still gradual hours later
stories.short: A worldwide Microsoft 365 outage from about 18:00 UTC on 12 November took down Outlook, Teams, Copilot, Defender for Office 365 and even the Intune admin tools. Microsoft blamed servers failing automated health checks; first fixes failed and recovery was still gradual hours later.

stat.label: UTC start of the outage, 12 Nov

stories.title: The Information reports the US Commerce Department is preparing to finalise a rule, possibly this month, barring Chinese AI companies from using advanced chips in data centres outside China and extending controls to seven more countries including Malaysia, Singapore and Thailand; Alibaba falls about 7%, and Reuters says tougher curbs are gaining support in Congress after Huang's exit
stories.short: The Information reports the US is preparing to finalise a rule, possibly this month, barring Chinese AI firms from using advanced chips in data centres abroad, extending controls to seven more countries including Malaysia, Singapore and Thailand. Alibaba fell about 7%. The rule text is not yet public.

stories.title: India's October consumer inflation rises to 6.09%, above the RBI's 6% upper tolerance limit, after the RBI's 25bp repo hike in October; industry bodies warn of further tightening, and large banks including HDFC Bank, Bank of Baroda, Canara Bank and Indian Bank raise fixed-deposit rates by up to 50bp, with top returns of 7.55%
stories.short: India's October inflation rose to 6.09%, above the RBI's 6% ceiling, after the central bank's 25bp hike in October. Industry bodies expect more tightening. HDFC Bank, Bank of Baroda, Canara Bank and others raised fixed-deposit rates by up to 50bp, with top returns of 7.55%.

stories.title: Nubank's Q3 2026: record $1.1B net income (+31%), revenue $6.3B (+37%), 143M customers; efficiency ratio 19.3% on lower personnel costs and full-year guidance cut to 19-19.5% from about 20%, which Reuters ties to AI slowing hiring; 90-day delinquency rises
stories.short: Nubank made a record $1.1bn in Q3 and reached 143m customers. Its efficiency ratio improved to 19.3% on lower personnel costs, and it cut full-year cost guidance to 19-19.5%. Reuters says the CFO tied slower hiring to AI; that link is not in the filing itself.

stories.title: CD&R and GTCR drop their pursuit of a take-private of Global Payments after several weeks of early talks, Reuters reports, citing the complexity of a buyout of this size; Global Payments shares fall about 9-12% on 12 Nov, roughly erasing the jump when the talks emerged on 30 Oct
stories.short: CD&R and GTCR have dropped their pursuit of a take-private of Global Payments, Reuters reports, citing the complexity of a buyout this size. The shares fell about 10% on 12 November, roughly reversing the jump when the talks emerged on 30 October.

stories.title: Deutsche Bank's Digital Asset Custody service goes live for paying institutional and corporate clients in Europe, holding Bitcoin, Ether, USDC, EURC and EURAU with the bank managing wallets and keys, after BaFin authorisation under MiCA
stories.short: Deutsche Bank's Digital Asset Custody service is live for paying institutional and corporate clients in Europe. The bank holds keys for Bitcoin, Ether and the USDC, EURC and EURAU stablecoins, after BaFin authorisation under MiCA. It is also part of the Project Faro bank stablecoin consortium.

stat.label: assets held: BTC, ETH and three stablecoins

stories.title: Visa partners with Anchorage Digital to let eligible partners settle with Western Union's USDPT stablecoin, issued by Anchorage Digital Bank, with a framework for more Anchorage tokens; SoFi's bank-issued SoFiUSD goes live on Polygon the same day
stories.short: Visa will let eligible partners settle in USDPT, Western Union's dollar stablecoin issued by Anchorage Digital Bank, with room for more Anchorage tokens. SoFi's bank-issued SoFiUSD also went live on Polygon, and Bottomline made its first USDC transfers. Stablecoin settlement is entering card-network plumbing.

stat.label: Western Union's stablecoin, now on Visa

stories.title: The US Justice Department wins court authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2B of the $6.3B stolen from Binance in October (part of $2.7B frozen), attributes the theft to North Korea's TraderTraitor, and the FBI disrupts 'FaceStealer', a North Korean deepfake video-call scheme it says stole $400M+ in 18 months
stories.short: The US Justice Department won court authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2bn of the $6.3bn stolen from Binance in October, which it blames on North Korea's TraderTraitor group. The FBI also disrupted FaceStealer, a deepfake video-call scheme it says stole over $400m in crypto.

stat.label: Binance theft proceeds the DOJ can seize

stories.title: A campaign dubbed 'wfx-loot' uses about 4,800 hijacked GitHub accounts to open pull requests that inject malicious workflows into tens of thousands of repositories, stealing GitHub Actions secrets and cloud credentials from at least 1,835 targets
stories.short: A campaign called wfx-loot used about 4,800 hijacked GitHub accounts to slip malicious workflows into repositories via pull requests, stealing GitHub Actions secrets and cloud credentials from at least 1,835 targets. Teams should restrict workflow permissions and rotate CI-exposed keys.

stories.title: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.71 (11 Nov) fixes critical CVE-2026-119618, a race condition in mod_http2's assign_headers() that can corrupt heap memory and give unauthenticated remote code execution in 2.4.55-2.4.70; it was found by Anthropic's OSS Scanner and Google Cloud's vulnerability research team
stories.short: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.71 fixes critical CVE-2026-119618, an HTTP/2 race condition that lets unauthenticated attackers run code on versions 2.4.55 to 2.4.70. Anthropic's OSS Scanner and Google's researchers found it. Patch or disable HTTP/2 on exposed servers.

stories.title: Researcher Chaotic Eclipse (Nightmare Eclipse) releases 'SignDrop', an unpatched Windows zero-day exploit that gives SYSTEM privileges by abusing the mitigation Microsoft added in October 2025 to protect the CLFS driver
stories.short: A researcher has published SignDrop, an unpatched Windows exploit that gives attackers SYSTEM privileges by abusing the very mitigation Microsoft added in 2025 to protect the CLFS driver. It lands two days after Patch Tuesday, so no fix exists yet.

stories.title: Google launches the Gemini Decisions API, powered by a new Gemini Decision 1 model, for fast calibrated yes/no, choice and rubric decisions across text, images, audio, video and PDFs (up to 1,000 questions per pass) at $0.10 per million input tokens with free output; it joins TypeSafe's Jev and OpenAI in the decision-model category
stories.short: Google launched the Gemini Decisions API, powered by Gemini Decision 1, which returns calibrated probabilities for up to 1,000 yes/no, choice or rubric questions over text, images, audio, video or PDFs. Input costs $0.10 per million tokens and output is free. It follows Jev and OpenAI into decision models.

stat.label: per million input tokens; output free

stories.title: Fed Governor Michael Barr, at Yale, says the US should prepare for 'serious' short-term AI job disruption and widening inequality: AI may already substitute for younger, less-experienced workers in some sectors, and the labour share of income hit a record-low 52.8% in Q2 2026
stories.short: Fed Governor Michael Barr said the US should prepare for serious short-term AI job disruption and wider inequality, with early signs AI is replacing younger, less-experienced workers in some sectors. The labour share of income hit a record low of 52.8% in Q2 2026.

stat.label: US labour share of income, Q2 2026

stories.title: A forensic report by former OpenAI researcher Will DePue (Unemployment Labs) says six open-weight models from DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, MiniMax and Ant Group released since April 2026 carry numerical fingerprints of export-controlled Nvidia Blackwell GPUs, suggesting the labs trained on banned hardware
stories.short: A former OpenAI researcher's forensic report says six open-weight models from DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, MiniMax and Ant Group released since April carry numerical fingerprints of export-controlled Nvidia Blackwell GPUs. No one has independently reproduced it and the labs have not responded.

stat.label: Chinese models flagged in the report

stories.title: Four nonprofits sue Anthropic, Google, Meta, OpenAI and SpaceX's AI units in San Francisco Superior Court, asking the court to halt development of AI models more advanced than today's frontier, citing the companies' own leaders' warnings about existential risk
stories.short: Four nonprofits sued Anthropic, Google, Meta, OpenAI and SpaceX's AI units in San Francisco Superior Court, asking for a halt to models more advanced than today's frontier. They cite the companies' own warnings about existential risk. No regulator has tried such an order.

stories.title: AWS releases AWS Emulator, a free local emulator of 200+ AWS services whose code was written entirely by thousands of autonomous AI agents that write tests, find issues and fix code without human review; source is on GitHub under CC0
stories.short: AWS released AWS Emulator, a free local emulator of more than 200 AWS services that it says was written entirely by thousands of autonomous AI agents testing and fixing code without human review. The code is on GitHub under CC0. It drew 965 points on Hacker News.

stories.title: Cerebras reports Q3 core adjusted revenue of $230.9M (+70%, vs $214.7M expected), raises its outlook, says revenue should triple in 2027 and announces a Microsoft deal; shares jump about 17-18% after hours, though reports say it is behind on its first OpenAI capacity tranches
stories.short: Cerebras reported Q3 core revenue of $230.9m, up 70% and above forecasts, announced a Microsoft deal and said revenue should triple in 2027. Shares rose about 17% after hours, though it is reportedly behind on its first OpenAI capacity tranches.

stories.title: German robot maker Agile Robots raises a $500M Series F led by SoftBank with Nvidia, Hitachi and T Capital at an $8.5B valuation to scale its force-sensitive manipulation, dexterous hands and Agile ONE humanoid; reports say it follows China blocking an ABB robotics deal
stories.short: Germany's Agile Robots raised a $500m Series F led by SoftBank, with Nvidia and Hitachi, at an $8.5bn valuation. Its robots use force-sensitive manipulation and dexterous hands, and it builds the Agile ONE humanoid. Total funding reaches $2bn.

stories.title: Q-CTRL raises a $290M Series C led by Salesforce Ventures to scale its AI-driven quantum control software, and AMD expands its PsiQuantum partnership to Instinct GPUs, EPYC CPUs and ROCm alongside PsiQuantum's photonic chips, with a planned AMD equity investment; quantum stocks fell after Rigetti's CEO said quantum cannot yet prove ROI
stories.short: Q-CTRL raised a $290m Series C led by Salesforce Ventures for its AI-driven quantum control software. AMD expanded its PsiQuantum partnership to GPUs, CPUs and ROCm and plans an equity stake. Listed quantum stocks fell after Rigetti's CEO said quantum cannot yet prove ROI.

stories.title: Google DeepMind releases AlphaGenome 2, which predicts how DNA variants affect gene regulation in hundreds of specific human cell types, trained on 100M+ single-cell profiles across 68 tissues and finding nearly twice as many expression-changing variants as before; available for non-commercial research via API
stories.short: Google DeepMind released AlphaGenome 2, which predicts how DNA variants change gene activity in hundreds of specific human cell types. Trained on over 100 million single-cell profiles, it finds nearly twice as many expression-changing variants as before. Researchers can use it free for non-commercial work.

stories.title: Indonesia's vice-president Gibran Rakabuming Raka, son of former president Joko Widodo, resigns after the Supreme Court found no evidence he completed senior secondary school, a legal requirement for the office; the BBC says it signals President Prabowo's ruling alliance is fraying
stories.short: Indonesia's vice-president Gibran Rakabuming Raka, son of former president Joko Widodo, resigned after the Supreme Court found no evidence he had completed senior secondary school, a legal requirement for the job. The BBC sees signs President Prabowo's alliance is fraying.

stat.label: in line to the presidency, now vacant

stories.title: An Israeli strike on Nasser hospital in Khan Younis kills six of the 11 people killed in Gaza on 12 Nov, the deadliest single strike since Israel's October election; Israel says it targeted a Hamas commander, Hamas calls it a war crime and the Board of Peace urges the ceasefire plan be implemented
stories.short: Israeli fire killed 11 people in Gaza on 12 November, six of them in a strike on Nasser hospital, the deadliest single strike since Israel's October election. Israel says it targeted a Hamas commander; Hamas called it a war crime and the Board of Peace urged the ceasefire plan be implemented.

stories.title: Alibaba opens a Qwen4-Max preview on its Token Plan with a 1M-token context until 25 November, the first access to its next-generation Qwen 4 family; YouTube previews of a Qwen 4 27B draw tens of thousands of views
stories.short: Alibaba opened a Qwen4-Max preview to Token Plan subscribers with a 1M-token context until 25 November, Pandaily reports: the first access to the Qwen 4 generation. There are no open weights or official benchmarks yet.

stat.label: tokens of context in the preview

stories.update: New since Wednesday: Kalshi dropped Donald Trump Jr. as an adviser and is reportedly raising at $65bn; no CFTC charges yet.
stories.short: Kalshi ended Donald Trump Jr.'s advisory role after his firm invested in rival Polymarket, and Bloomberg says it is in talks to raise at a $65bn valuation weeks after a $40bn round. The CFTC's warned charges have not been filed yet.

stories.title: SpaceX's compute build-out grows to more than $74B: on top of the ~$24B Starbase, Texas, gas plant and supercomputing site, it plans about $50B for a 6GW supercomputing campus in Cochise County, Arizona, using dry cooling and no groundwater
stories.update: Now $74bn+: a ~$50bn, 6GW dry-cooled campus in Arizona on top of the ~$24bn Starbase project.
stories.short: SpaceX now plans more than $74bn of AI computing sites: the roughly $24bn Starbase project in Texas plus about $50bn for a 6-gigawatt campus in Arizona that will use dry cooling and no groundwater. Starship Flight 15 is due on 13 November.

stories.title: Brent briefly jumps back to about $96 after President Trump says the US has no need for an Iran deal, reversing its dip below $90; the Saudi-led coalition intercepts a third Houthi drone over the Eastern Province, Iran's Guards blame an 'accident' for two tankers on fire in Hormuz, and the UN extends Houthi sanctions to November 2027
stories.update: Brent back to ~$96 on Trump's Iran comments; tankers on fire in Hormuz; a third Houthi drone intercepted.
stories.short: Brent briefly jumped back to about $96 after President Trump said the US has no need for an Iran deal, a day after falling below $90. Two tankers caught fire in Hormuz and Saudi forces intercepted a third Houthi drone.

stories.update: Talks ended with a prisoner swap; Putin then told US envoys he will not compromise on Donetsk or foreign troops.
